page_title: GitHub - pedrovieira/Holeberry: A native and modern macOS menu bar app to monitor and control your Pi-hole instances

summary.name: Holeberry
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app for monitoring and controlling Pi-hole instances without opening the Pi-hole web interface.
use_cases: Check Pi-hole blocking status and query stats from the menu bar
Temporarily disable Pi-hole blocking for a set time
Unblock a domain that breaks a page in the current browser tab
Allowlist or unblock recently blocked domains
Manage up to two Pi-hole instances at once
Trigger blocklist (gravity) updates on all servers
summary.what_it_does: Holeberry is a macOS menu bar app that shows Pi-hole blocking status and aggregated query and blocked-domain counts. It can disable blocking globally for a set time or indefinitely, with a countdown timer that re-enables blocking automatically. It detects the current tab in supported browsers and unblocks that domain with one click, and it can allowlist or unblock recently blocked domains. It also triggers gravity updates on all configured servers, with optional scheduled updates. It supports Pi-hole v6 and v5 (v5 not fully tested) and up to two instances, applying every action to all of them.
notable: Applies every action to all configured Pi-hole instances at once, with per-server status dots
Browser-tab unblocking for Safari, Orion, Chrome/Chromium, and Firefox/Zen-based browsers
Stores passwords in the macOS Keychain; supports password-less instances
Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple; open source on GitHub
caveats: Pi-hole v5 support is not fully tested
Limited to Pi-hole (AdGuard Home and Technitium are only future wishlist items); deep configuration like adlists and DHCP stays in the web interface
